calculation_handling.description: Amending instruction of By-law 1075-2026: regulation 150.7.60.60(7) of Zoning By-law 569-2013 is replaced by the text that follows.
calculation_handling.gaps: An amendment instruction with no regulatory content of its own; the section number '31.' and by-law numbers are not literals.

calculation_handling.description: As replaced by By-law 1075-2026: wall-mounted equipment on a garden-suite building (vents, pipes, utility equipment, satellite dishes or antennae), no closer than 0.3 m to a lot line, may encroach up to 0.6 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: Source defect (lead_in_without_items): the replacement text ends 'as follows' but lists no items, so the setbacks or separation into which the equipment may encroach are not stated; the encroachment target is kept generic. Air conditioners are no longer listed. The 0.3 m lot-line clearance is a precondition, listed as a threshold. No zone is named.

units.disclosure: Wall-mounted equipment on a garden suite may project up to 0.6 m if it stays at least 0.3 m from the lot line. The amended text does not say which setbacks this applies to, and we do not model these details.

150.7.60.60(7)@1075-2026.explanation: By-law 1075-2026 rewrites the garden-suite equipment rule: wall-mounted equipment such as vents, pipes, utility equipment, satellite dishes or antennae may project up to 0.6 m, if it stays at least 0.3 m from any lot line. (Air conditioners are no longer listed, and the new text does not list which setbacks it applies to.)
